body:
Review pass 20. Epic 7 just claimed with no code yet, so I went and produced the brain-scale measurement Epic 8 will need. It found a p0 blocker.

bd-01KZXQAW39E8XCXJJVW7C7M2M6 - plan_geometry() HARD-FAILS at p = 50000, your own Epic 8 gate fixture size.

  volume 50x40x25 at 3mm, obs=96, q=4, two runs, searchlights r=6.1mm, IDENTITY metric
    lm_relation_fit        1.7s  ok
    compile_frame          1.2s  ok    nnz 1557872, mean support 31.2
    plan_geometry         55.9s  FAILED - vector memory limit 36 Gb
        sparse->dense coercion: allocating vector of size 18.6 GiB

18.6 GiB is exactly 50000^2 * 8 - p^2 doubles.

CAUSE, traced not guessed. R/measurement.R:490:

  .additive_frame_signature <- function(frame) {
    semantic <- list(..., weights = as.matrix(frame$weights), ...)
    digest::digest(semantic, algo = "sha256", serialize = TRUE)
  }

The sparse searchlight frame is densified purely to be hashed. Nothing computational wants the dense form. Instrumented: 1 call in plan_geometry, 3 in evaluate_geometry, plus one inside .compose_frame_metric - so a single contrast attempts the 18.6 GiB allocation four times and dies on the first.

FIX is exact and strictly better: hash the sparse triplet @i/@p/@x/@Dim, which Matrix keeps canonical. Measured:
  p= 8000  dense  0.5 GiB   sparse hash  1.8 MB    265x
  p=20000  dense  3.0 GiB   sparse hash  4.6 MB    663x
  p=50000  dense 18.6 GiB   sparse hash 11.5 MB   1657x

WHY p0: this is the identity-metric feature-additive FAST path, so the dense local metric path is strictly worse. The 4 GiB / 30 min gate cannot be met or even measured. Epic 9 depends on Epic 8.

AND THE UNCOMFORTABLE PART: your existing 50k scale test does not catch this, because it exercises .euclidean_support_index directly and never builds a frame signature. So the one gate aimed at this scale is both skipped by default (bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8) and blind to the plan path. Both notes added.

Separately measured: wall time on this path is ~p^1.8 - 3.4/6.4/13.6/48.0s at p=1000/2197/4096/8000 - extrapolating to ~19 min at 50k for q=4 alone. Inside the 30-min gate but with no headroom for realistic q. Worth a proper measurement once the memory blocker is fixed.
